cape.localcapes.account.migrator.name: Migrator Cape
cape.localcapes.account.migrator.desc:
Players who bought Minecraft: Java Edition before December 1, 2020 got this cape when migrating their account.

The cape was first given out around July 9, 2021 and could be obtained until the end of the migration period on September 19, 2023.
cape.localcapes.account.vanilla.name: Vanilla Cape
cape.localcapes.account.vanilla.desc:
Players were able to obtain the cape under the condition that both Java Edition and Bedrock Edition for Windows are owned in the same Microsoft account before June 6, 2022.

The top of this cape is a grass block and the bottom is bedrock, representing Java Edition and Bedrock Edition.
cape.localcapes.account.pan.name: The Pan Cape
cape.localcapes.account.pan.desc:
This cape was originally used as a placeholder to create other capes, such as the Founder's Cape.

Standard version: players who joined Bedrock's development versions (then Minecraft Beta) could use it temporarily. Since Bedrock Edition 1.16.0 it has been given to all Bedrock players. Since May 8, 2025 it is also given to all Java Edition players by default, including later purchases. Opening Bedrock is not required; there may be a short delay after purchase.

Duplicate version (Bedrock only): originally the Mojang Studios Cape. After an exploit let non-employees claim it, its texture and name were changed to this cape, so it appears as a duplicate. Rarity changed from Legendary to Common. Claimants can still equip it in the Character Creator.
cape.localcapes.account.common.name: Common Cape
cape.localcapes.account.common.desc: Players who used their Microsoft account to log into Bedrock Edition on any platform during the distribution period received this cape in both Bedrock Edition and Java Edition. A Microsoft account is required to obtain this cape, even on platforms where using one is not required to play the game.
cape.localcapes.staff.mojang_classic.des:
The Classic Mojang Cape was given to those employed by Mojang at any point between December 20, 2010 and October 7, 2015. It was also given out to Mojang employees on Xbox 360 Edition.

This cape was not given out on Bedrock Edition.
cape.localcapes.staff.mojang.name: Mojang Cape
cape.localcapes.staff.mojang.desc:
The Mojang Cape was given to those employed by Mojang at any point between October 7, 2015 and July 25, 2021.

This cape was not given out on Bedrock Edition.
cape.localcapes.staff.mojang_studios.des:
This cape is given to those employed by Mojang Studios on or after July 25, 2021. It was designed by Johan Aronson.

The cape is kept indefinitely even if the employee leaves Mojang, unless manually revoked.
cape.localcapes.staff.4j_studios.name: 4J Studios Cape
cape.localcapes.staff.4j_studios.desc: This cape was presumably given out to 4J Studios developers on Xbox 360 Edition through the "Title Managed Storage" developer feature. However, it may simply be an unused asset, as no reliable sources have acknowledged the cape outside of the data dump that revealed it.
cape.localcapes.staff.microsoft_xbox_360: This cape was given out to Microsoft employees, who were also given the ability to toggle the cape's visibility.

cape.localcapes.event_physical.minecraft:
Players can receive this cape by redeeming a code rewarded after completing Minecraft Experience: Villager Rescue. Codes must be redeemed no later than 30 days after the event closes in the tour city where they were obtained.

The code is distributed in one of two ways, depending on the city. Some cities email the code after the visit. Others print it on a card when the Orb of Interaction is returned at the end of the experience. Cities that use printed cards do not send code emails; the code must be collected at the experience.
cape.localcapes.event_physical.moonlight: Players can receive this cape by redeeming a code sent by email within 72 hours after completing Minecraft Experience: Moonlight Trail. Codes must be redeemed no later than 30 days after the event closes in the tour city where they were obtained.
cape.localcapes.event_physical.crafter.d:
This cape could be obtained at the in-person TwitchCon 2026 event in Rotterdam, May 30–31, 2026.

Guests received an inventory ribbon to attach to their TwitchCon badge at pickup. Participating in Minecraft content sessions or arena activities awarded emerald stickers. After collecting three stickers, the ribbon could be taken to the Cape Trader booth for a code card, which redeemed this cape.

Invited content creators playtesting new features were given extra codes to give away to viewers. Online players could obtain a virtual version of the cape through other means.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.15th_anniv: Available from May 17 to June 22, 2024 as part of Minecraft's 15th anniversary. Users claimed it from a section on the Minecraft.net 15th anniversary page, after which it appeared in both Java Edition and Bedrock Edition.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.cherry_blo:
Java Edition: given to players who voted in the 2023 Mob Vote through minecraft.net, the Minecraft Launcher, or the 2023 Mob Vote Event server. Joining the server without voting did not grant the cape.

Bedrock Edition: given to players who joined the 2023 Mob Vote Event server. Voting without joining the server did not grant the cape.

For unknown reasons, some players who received the cape on Bedrock did not receive it on Java. There may also be a limit on how many players from the same IP can receive it. Minecraft Support has said it was given for voting on any platform, which does not match the actual Bedrock distribution.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.mcc_15th_y: Obtained by completing all 15 challenges in the MCC x Minecraft 15th Anniversary Party event server.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.purple_hea:
Players could receive this cape by redeeming a code obtained by watching any Minecraft livestream on Twitch for 15 minutes. Codes were available between May 15 and May 31, 2024.

Players who owned the Bedrock Purple Heart Cape received the Java Edition cape between July 2 and July 8, 2024.

This could not be completed normally where Twitch or its rewards program were unavailable. Players in those regions could obtain the cape by traveling to a region where they were available, or by receiving a code from another player.
Players could receive this cape by redeeming a code obtained by watching any Minecraft livestream on TikTok. The event started on May 18, 2024 and ended on June 18, 2024.

Depending on the region, there were extra requirements, such as watching for some time or typing "minecraft" in chat.

This could not be completed normally where TikTok or its rewards program were unavailable. Players in those regions could obtain the cape by traveling to a region where they were available, or by receiving a code from another player.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.founders.d:
Players could obtain the Founder's cape skin pack from the Marketplace for free for a limited time during MINECON Live 2019. Only Steve and Alex could use the cape with the skin pack. Players who had claimed it later received the cape as a Character Creator item when Character Creator launched. It is no longer available in the Marketplace.

Players who owned this cape received the Java Edition Founder's Cape after May 8, 2025.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.progress_p: The cape was obtainable for free through the Marketplace during the Pride 2023 Sale as part of a collection of Character Creator pieces. Players were not given the cape automatically. It is only available in certain regions, and could no longer be claimed after August 2023.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.builder.de:
Redeem a code obtained by watching any livestream on Twitch for 5 minutes, or on TikTok for 3 minutes. This could be done between May 30 and June 14 (later extended to June 22), 2026. All codes must be redeemed by June 30, 2026.

This could not be completed normally where those platforms or their rewards programs were unavailable. Players in those regions could obtain the cape by traveling to a region where they were available, or by receiving a code from another player.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.home.name: Home Cape
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.home.desc:
Players could receive this cape by redeeming a code obtained by watching any Minecraft livestream on Twitch for three minutes, between March 18 and April 6, 2025. It was part of the A Minecraft Movie promotion.

This could not be completed normally where Twitch or its rewards program were unavailable. Players in those regions could obtain the cape by traveling to a region where they were available, or by receiving a code from another player.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.menace.des:
Players could receive this cape by redeeming a code obtained by watching any Minecraft livestream on TikTok for three minutes, between March 18 and April 6, 2025.

This could not be completed normally where TikTok or its rewards program were unavailable. Players in those regions could obtain the cape by traveling to a region where they were available, or by receiving a code from another player.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.copper.des:
The final reward of "The Copper Cape Quest", a three-part community challenge that began on September 30, 2025. Obtain it by completing one of these tasks:

October 13 (15:00 UTC) – October 20, 2025 (17:00 UTC): place a copper golem statue anywhere in Bedrock Edition, any game mode.

Same window: watch a participating livestream (Twitch 5 minutes, or TikTok 3 minutes). Redeem codes until November 19, 2025.

October 17–19, 2025: claim a code at The Copper Crown event in San Diego. Redeem until November 19, 2025.

Players who owned the Bedrock Copper Cape received the Java Edition cape after October 15, 2025.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.yearn.name: Yearn Cape
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.yearn.desc:
Obtained by completing all 6 quests in the A Minecraft Movie Live Event, hosted on Bedrock Edition from March 25 to April 14, 2025.

Players who owned the Bedrock Yearn Cape received the Java Edition cape after April 5, 2025.
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.zombie_hor:
Reward for the "Spear Mayhem" challenge, December 12, 2025 (16:00 UTC) to December 15, 2025 (18:00 UTC). Kill 5 mobs with a spear in Survival on Bedrock Edition. The five kills can be separate; any neutral or hostile mob counts. Switching from Creative to Survival was allowed.

Distribution began on December 18, 2025. Eligible players received the cape within about 30 days after the promotion ended (before January 14, 2026).
cape.localcapes.event_virtual.mojang_off:
Obtained by completing all five daily challenges in the Eerie Mojang Office Party event server.

Players who owned this cape received the Java Edition Mojang Office Cape after December 13, 2024.
cape.localcapes.personal.turtle.name: Turtle Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.turtle.desc: Given to billyK_ for his suggestion of turtles, which was implemented into the game. It was also given to some Mojang-owned accounts for endpoint testing, including Michael Andersson and el_hefe_; el_hefe_'s cape was later removed.
cape.localcapes.personal.millionth_custo: Given to akronman1, who purchased the 1,000,000th copy of the game. The cape was made by @Kinten.
cape.localcapes.personal.bacon.name: Bacon Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.bacon.desc: Given to Miclee by Notch for his idea of adding pigmen. The cape was made by Miclee himself. It was later revoked due to a large influx of players asking Notch for their own capes.
cape.localcapes.personal.mrmessiah.name: MrMessiah's Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.mrmessiah.desc: Given to MrMessiah as gratitude for developing the BetterLight mod, which was integrated into the game and is responsible for Minecraft's lighting and grass features. It was discussed in 2011 but not granted until 2015. The artist is unknown; MrMessiah suggested it "might have been Jeb".
cape.localcapes.personal.cheapsh0t.name: cheapsh0t's Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.cheapsh0t.desc: Unlike the similar-looking Translator and Chinese Translator capes, this cape was given to cheapsh0t for helping the Mojang Studios team when they visited Tokyo, Japan in September 2013.
cape.localcapes.personal.dannybstyle.des: Given to the video game music composer dannyBstyle, as Notch was a fan of his music.
cape.localcapes.personal.julianclark.des:
Given to JulianClark as a reward for a meme about bringing Ray Cokes to Notch, after the splash text "Bring me Ray Cokes!" Ray is apparently his godfather.

JulianClark's account was later lost for not migrating during the Mojang account migration, and may have been deleted.
cape.localcapes.personal.oxeye.name: Oxeye Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.oxeye.desc:
Oxeye Game Studio was a game studio founded by Jeb and others, known for games such as Cobalt.

This cape was randomly given to the player iSxckk, presumably by accident, then removed the next day.
cape.localcapes.personal.prismarine.name: Prismarine Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.prismarine.desc: Given to Drullkus by Jeb as appreciation for creating his own prismarine block texture for the Chisel mod instead of modifying Mojang's textures.
cape.localcapes.personal.birthday.name: Birthday Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.birthday.desc: Given to the account Gr8Bizzo, which belongs to Todd Baldwin, a Mojang employee who led work on minecraft.net.
cape.localcapes.personal.valentine.name: Valentine Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.valentine.desc:
Given to LolFoxy2 by Mojang employee Ekkelangelo, who had become friends with them and helped resolve migration problems on their alternative account. It was removed twenty minutes later after its rarity was discovered.

It was also given to JoinGrave, presumably by accident, and removed two days later.
cape.localcapes.personal.blueprint.name: Blueprint Cape
cape.localcapes.personal.blueprint.desc: The texture was created on November 23, 2015. On November 26, 2025 it was given to SupaCookiebrat for unknown reasons and subsequently removed, making them the only known owner of the Blueprint Cape.
cape.localcapes.competition.scrolls_cham:
Starting November 7, 2014, given to players who earned first place on the Scrolls weekly ladder five separate times. Capes stopped being given out on September 30, 2015, because player counts had gotten too low to remain competitive.

During MINECON 2015, the top four players of the Scrolls MINECON Open also received the cape.

On December 11–12, 2014, all players were temporarily shown with this cape to celebrate the release of Scrolls.
cape.localcapes.competition.cobalt.name: Cobalt Cape
cape.localcapes.competition.cobalt.desc: Given to participants and winners of the Cobalt Workshop Challenge level-making competitions and the Cobalt League tournaments in 2016. The elytra design is based on Cobalt's wasp enemies.
cape.localcapes.volunteer.translator.des: Given to proofreaders notable for their contribution. In Minecraft's Crowdin translation project, this cape was awarded to 29 translators after a fair dice roll, and later to more translators from time to time. Jeb then cancelled the program after seeing machine translation and malicious downvotes of good translations. As of May 7, 2016, the program appears to have resumed.
cape.localcapes.volunteer.chinese_transl: Given to Powup333, Craft_Lawrence, and sjjklh for their contribution in Chinese.
cape.localcapes.volunteer.mapmaker.name: Mapmaker Cape
cape.localcapes.volunteer.mapmaker.desc: Given to contributors who meet the criteria at atlas.minecraft.net/guidelines#capes. Publishing maps to Realms awards points; creators with 8 points become eligible. Capes are not automatically given out and require good standing in the community.
cape.localcapes.volunteer.moderator.name: Moderator Cape
cape.localcapes.volunteer.moderator.desc:
Given to current and past moderators on Mojira. To become a moderator, a community member needs to be consistently active in assisting with the bug tracker's moderation and become a helper first.

First given to bug tracker moderators on December 25, 2014, and awarded again starting May 9, 2016.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.hero.desc: A cape for heroes brave enough to face the Arch-Illager. Included in Hero Edition, Hero Pass, Ultimate Edition, and the Ultimate DLC Bundle. The texture gained the Minecraft Dungeons icon in 1.2.0.0.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.sinister.desc: Old and torn, this cape struggles to keep up with the wind. A thank-you to 10 million players, given out on February 24, 2021.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.phantom.desc: No need to panic — this Phantom cape is real. Obtained in the Spookier Fall event by completing 6 seasonal trials (Oct 13 – Nov 2, 2021).
cape.localcapes.dungeons.year1.desc: A confectionary-inspired cape. Obtained by completing 7 Anniversary Event seasonal trials. First available May 26, 2021.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.downpour.desc: A stormcloud in cape form. Free Cloudy Climb Seasonal Adventure reward at Rank 50.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.prism.desc: A black cape with a white stripe that hits a triangle and splits into a rainbow. Premium Cloudy Climb reward at Rank 25.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.cloudy_climb.de: The signature cape of Cloudy Climb (Season 1). Premium Seasonal Adventure reward at Rank 50.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.iceologer.desc: Chill out with the Iceologer cape. Given to Festival of Frost participants.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.glow.desc: Glows in the dark from glow squid ink. Free Luminous Night Seasonal Adventure reward at Rank 50.
The signature cape of Luminous Night. Premium Seasonal Adventure reward at Rank 11.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.amethyst.desc: Lovingly adorned with sparkling amethyst. Premium Luminous Night reward at Rank 25.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.gift_wrap.desc: On the second anniversary: a celebration of the gift that keeps giving — you. Given to Second Anniversary event participants.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.cow_crusader.de: An udderly awesome addition. Fauna Faire Seasonal Adventure reward.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.turtle_shell.de: With this cape on your back, you're ready for any attack. Fauna Faire Seasonal Adventure reward.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.fauna_faire.des: The signature cape of Fauna Faire. Seasonal Adventure reward.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.ominous.desc: Despite its floaty look, this cape feels heavy. Obtained in Spookiest Fall by completing 6 seasonal trials (Oct 26 – Nov 9, 2022).
cape.localcapes.dungeons.hammer.desc: The mark of blacksmiths and soldiers. Not obtainable in-game.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.iron_golem.desc: Made to honor the protectors of villagers. Not obtainable in-game. An early description said it resembled the MINECON 2015 cape.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.mystery.desc: Nobody can decipher its message, but it seems made for you. Not obtainable in-game. The symbols are Illageralt numbers that translate to 526.
cape.localcapes.dungeons.red_royal.desc: The old plain-red Hero Cape from public beta. Not obtainable in-game.
